spans.text: I believe this is the first time we meet in person. Glad to see you're punctual.
...Actually, you've come a bit too early. Mr. Kryuger is still attending to some other business.
Now let me fill you in on why we've called you in this time.
Persica has pieced together a few keywords from the intel acquired from Safe House 3 by the AR Team.
At this stage, we can safely assume that Sangvis Ferri is plotting to initiate an unknown plan codenamed 'Parapluie'.
No matter how this plan is implemented, it will undoubtedly pose an immense threat to Griffin.
Which is why Mr. Kryuger has decided to call an emergency meeting here at our secret base to discuss countermeasures with several field commanders.
Commander, this base isn't very far from your control center so you can continue to manage your troops here.
You may participate in an operation drill while we wait for Mr. Kryuger and the others to assemble.
Test the current efficiency of our T-Dolls and update the HQ database.
